title: Research Outpost Lab

provenance.author: codex/enterable-building-pilot
provenance.note: Every vertex and collider is generated from this recipe by tools/building-delivery/build-lab.mjs. There is NO external, downloaded, licensed or paid asset input. The only build inputs are this recipe and the committed generator sources; a clean checkout rebuilds byte-identical outputs with Node alone.

license.text: Original procedural geometry and data. Dedicated to the public domain (CC0-1.0); usable without attribution or credential.

generator.dependencies: none (pure Node stdlib; a hand-written GLB writer, no three.js, no gltf-transform)

units.gameConversion: 1:1 — the recipe is authored directly in PowerWorld world units, so no scale is applied at import. The metre figure is documentation only.
units.derivation: Measured from the runtime, not guessed: src/engine/citytiles.js door metric `DH = 11.2 * M` is commented 'a 2.1m doorway', so 2.1 m / 11.2 u = 0.1875 m/u; the same file builds a 9.6u human = 1.8 m. 1 m = 5.3333 u.

axes.note: Building origin (0,0,0) is the ground-centre of the footprint, floor plane at y=0. The entrance faces +Z; the breach panel is on the +X flank. The runtime places the building by an (x,z) world centre and a yaw; these local axes rotate with that yaw.

fitting.note: Native fitting reference, measured from runtime source constants (the handoff's instruction: use native Sarge scale, do not guess a metre conversion). Cited so a reviewer can re-check.
fitting.soldierHeroHeightSource: src/engine/citytiles.js metric comment '9.6u human = 1.8m'; soldiers (SARGE/MERC) are Fighters at the same radius and head height.
fitting.largeHeroSource: CLAUDE.md frame audit — RAGE 12.47u tall, OLYMPUS 9.44u wide (wings). Collision radius stays 2.2u; the extra width/height is visual silhouette.
fitting.nativeDoorSource: src/engine/citytiles.js door() `DH = 11.2 * M`; bungalow() shell door gap `doorW = 5.8 * M`.

knownGaps: Auto step-up: the current runtime moves by walk + jump + fly with no stair step-up (entity.js has no auto-climb). The stair GEOMETRY is walkable in proportion (riser <= 2.5u snap tolerance) but reaching the roof on foot needs either the movement step-up seam or jumping the steps; documented in INTEGRATION.md as an extension, validated geometrically by the fixture.

Multi-level colliders: world.interiors walls are single-storey floor->top columns. Stairs, the roof-as-second-level, breakable per-piece state, floor pieces and the breach opening are a superset needing the extension seam; the direct runtime-interior.json subset carries only the enterable ground floor.
Debris is a bounded SPEC (counts/sizes/lifetime/spawn volume), not baked chunk meshes; the runtime spawns them. No physics simulation of collapse is provided or implied.
The research case object itself is a FrontlineEncounter runtime entity; this package supplies the pedestal and the case_spawn waypoint, not the case.

Main task must verify native camera boom/cutaway, projectile collision, rain occlusion, AI pathing and destruction against this package in-engine; the standalone fixture proves geometry/clearance/LOS math only, not gameplay feel.
integration: See docs/building-delivery/INTEGRATION.md for the exact seam (direct subset + extension points).
